name: Tolstoy
q: The only important time is now
Spring is the time of plans and projects
Music is the shorthand of emotion
Live magnificently by working and loving
One gets used to anything, seeing others live so
I understand only because I love
Wrong is still wrong, even shared by many
The strongest of all warriors are time and patience
Life's meaning is to serve others
No greatness without simplicity, goodness, and truth
Happy families are alike; unhappy ones differ
All would mend the world, none himself
God sees the truth, but waits
Art is not craft but feeling conveyed
How much land does a man need?
Walk in the light while there is light
